title: SPP1+ TAM–myCAF immunosuppressive niche in intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma — analysis code
description: Integrative single-cell, spatial and multi-cohort survival re-analysis code for the SPP1+/TREM2+ TAM–myofibroblastic CAF niche in iCCA. All input datasets are public (GSE138709, GSE316402, GSE107943, E-MTAB-6389, TCGA-CHOL).
